name: lichtfeld_vr_editor
summary: View and edit Gaussian splat scenes in VR using Quest controllers through SteamVR.
description: Edit live Lichtfeld scenes in VR with sphere and oriented box selection, Center/Edge selection modes, deletion, and shared undo/redo. Navigate with joysticks and use grip gestures to pan, rotate, and scale the VR view.
author: MisterE123
